paragraphs: On Friday afternoon, the older students gave a short opera in the school hall. Teacher Kim and Teacher Nick wrote about it in their class chatrooms, and the show was free. After the performance, two pairs of friends talked about it at the school cafeteria.

Lily and Mia sat at a small table with a plate of toast and mushrooms. "The opera started at two o'clock," said Lily. "Teacher Kim told us in our class chatroom." "Yes, and it was one hour long," said Mia. "My favorite was the singer in the red dress, because her voice was perfect." "I liked the music with the drums," said Lily. "The story was about a small fish, and it was easy to follow," said Mia. "The end was very nice, because everybody sang together," said Lily. "The stage was small, but the performance was very big." "This toast is very good," said Mia. "I like the mushrooms on it." Lily smiled and took the last piece.

Tom and Ben sat at the next table with a plate of roast chicken and rice. "The opera started at two o'clock," said Ben. "Teacher Nick told us in our class chatroom." "Yes, and it was one hour long," said Tom. "My favorite was the man with the big voice." "I liked the music with the drums," said Ben. "The story was about a small fish, and it was easy to follow," said Tom. "The best part was the end, when everybody sang together," said Ben. "The first song was loud, but it was fun." "Do you want some chili sauce on your chicken?" asked Tom. "No, thank you," said Ben. "It is too hot for me."

Later, Lily and Tom met at the cafeteria door. "What did you eat?" asked Lily. "Roast chicken with rice, and a little chili sauce," said Tom. "And you?" "Toast with mushrooms," said Lily. "We had the same opera, but different food and a different favorite part." "That is true," said Tom with a smile.

That evening, Lily wrote a short post for the blog. She wrote, "Two pairs of friends saw the same opera." "They all saw the same fish story at two o'clock." "They all ate in the cafeteria." "But they did not choose the same food." Teacher Kim read the post and put it online.
